page_title: GoLand: The JetBrains IDE for Professional Go Engineering

sources.entry: GoLand - Provides ergonomic environment for Go development.

summary.name: GoLand
summary.one_liner: GoLand is JetBrains' IDE for Go development, with AI agent sessions, Go-aware search, refactoring, and code analysis.
use_cases: Developing backend services and APIs in Go
Reviewing and verifying code changes made by AI agents
Running multiple AI agents across one or more projects
Debugging, testing and profiling Go code before merging
Editing cloud configuration like Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform alongside Go code
summary.what_it_does: The page describes GoLand as a Go IDE where users can run and track multiple AI agent sessions, choosing whether each launches in the GUI or terminal. Agent sessions can be shown as running, done, or waiting, and users can comment on diff lines and send them back to the agent. GoLand uses Go semantics and project dependencies for search, navigation, context-aware inspections, and safe refactorings. It also offers deep code analysis such as nil-dereference and resource-leak checks, plus one-click debugging, testing, and profiling. The page says agents can run on the user's own API key, an existing plan, or JetBrains AI.
notable: Go semantics-based search, navigation, inspections and refactorings
Nil-dereference and resource-leak analysis to check code and agent output
Tracks multiple AI agent sessions with diff comments sent back to agents
Supports agents using own API key, existing plan, or JetBrains AI
caveats: Free 30-day trial is mentioned; paid use after the trial is implied but pricing details are not on the page
Agent use depends on user's own API key, a plan they already pay for, or JetBrains AI
